title: Final Differential Cross Section
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the expression for the differential scattering cross section as dσ/dΩ = 1/4 (R + r)^2.

title: Final Total Cross Section
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the total cross section as σ_t = π (R + r)^2.

title: Scattering Angle Relation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly relate the scattering angle Θ to the angle of incidence θ using the equation Θ = π - 2θ.

title: Use of Elastic Scattering
description: Important Criteria: The student must acknowledge that the scattering is elastic and that the massive billiard ball remains stationary.

title: Correct Use of Geometry
description: Optional Criteria: The student should correctly apply the geometric relationship (R + r) sin θ = b in their derivation.

title: Isotropic Distribution
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention that the differential cross section is isotropic in their explanation.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the derivation of the scattering angles or cross sections.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.
